text.description: Description of the sound effect to generate.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the sound effect in seconds, from 0.5 to 30.

loop.description: Create a sound effect that loops smoothly.

prompt_influence.description: How closely to follow the prompt, from 0 to 1 (default 0.3). Higher is closer and less varied.

output_format.description: Audio codec, sample rate and bitrate (default mp3_44100_128).
